name: Gabriel
title: God's messenger angel
summary: Gabriel is one of the chief angels in the Bible, known as God's messenger. He appears in both the Old and New Testaments with important messages from God, including the announcement of Jesus' birth to Mary and the message regarding Daniel's prophetic visions. His name means 'God's strength' or 'Man of God'.

keyEvents.title: Gabriel's explanation of Daniel's vision
keyEvents.description: Gabriel was sent to the prophet Daniel to explain the vision of the ram and the goat, which concerned future kingdoms and the end times.

keyEvents.title: The prophecy of the seventy weeks
keyEvents.description: Gabriel came to Daniel during prayer and revealed the prophecy of the seventy weeks, pointing forward to the coming of the Messiah and the rebuilding of Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Message to Zechariah about the Birth of John
keyEvents.description: Gabriel appeared to the priest Zechariah in the temple and announced that his wife Elizabeth would give birth to a son, John, who would prepare the way for the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Gabriel Introduces Himself by Name
keyEvents.description: When Zechariah doubted the message, Gabriel identified himself as one who stands before God and struck Zechariah with muteness as a sign.

keyEvents.title: The Annunciation to Mary
keyEvents.description: Gabriel was sent by God to the virgin Mary in Nazareth to announce that she would conceive by the Holy Spirit and give birth to God's Son, Jesus.

keyEvents.title: Daniel Strengthened and Comforted
keyEvents.description: Gabriel came to Daniel when he was exhausted and afraid, touched him to strengthen him, and gave him understanding of the prophetic visions about the future.
